message: Parity-oriented LONA validation on the same 100,000-bar LiteFinance MT5 dataset. The LONA strategy now mirrors the Python rolling EMA/ATR/RSI/MACD math, Static/OrderBlock proxy, AB=CD pattern check, previous broker-day pivots, 150-1200 point ATR stop bounds, 2R target and 0.5% risk sizing. The run also uses next-bar execution (buy_on_close=false) and higher CFD-style leverage to avoid cash-margin rejection. Result: -4.94% total return, 2,637 trades, 33.83% win rate, profit factor 0.99, expectancy -0.02 LONA units and 31.95% maximum drawdown. This replaces the earlier +30.21% result, which was inflated by execution/indicator parity differences. Variable MT5 bid/ask spread is still not reproduced exactly in LONA, so DEMO forward validation remains required.

diagnostics.spread_note: LONA uploaded OHLC feed does not reproduce the per-bar MT5 bid/ask spread used by the Python replay.
